Standard: Exposure to the sand and dust environment for the stated life documented in engine tech data does not adversely affect the engine beyond the capability established in 7.2 standards, nor result in exceeding defined engine operating limits, impairing functional capability (e.g., cooling and thermal management), detrimental permanent deformation, or damage when the engine is operated, under steady state and transient conditions, IAW 7.3.1. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Examine drawings or system configuration descriptions to verify incorporation of specific design features, components, or arrangements that enable engine sand and dust tolerance and capability (e.g., sump pressurization and ventilation inlets, buffer air particle separators, bleed paths). Analysis.
  (1) Conduct analysis to ensure proper sizing and shaping of cooling passages to prevent blockage or clogging from sand and dust.
  (2) Conduct analysis to determine components susceptible to damage or deterioration from sand and dust and verify that material and coating selections are tolerant to the defined sand and dust environment.
  (3) Conduct specific analyses defined in JSSG 2007, Appendix A, Verification section, Compressor Airfoil Erosion Coating paragraph if such coatings are part of the type design. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
    (1) Lab test: Full engine test in a sea-level test cell is necessary to determine the effect of sand ingestion on the performance, operability, lube system contamination, bleed air quality, internal air-cooling system (e.g., secondary flow circuits), compressor erosion coatings, integrated heat exchanger effectiveness, and durability. Specific test conditions (e.g., sand types, sand concentration, exposure duration, engine power settings) are selected to simulate mission exposure conditions including powered lift, hover, brown out using JSSG 2007, Appendix A, Verification section, Sand and Dust Ingestion paragraph as guidance. Include inlet particle separator during sand ingestion test if part of type design.
    (2) Lab test: Conduct specific rig and engine tests defined in JSSG 2007, Appendix A, Verification section, Compressor Airfoil Erosion Coating paragraph if such coatings are part of the type design.
